clips.title: The story
paras: The Master's Glaive is an ancient, unsettling landmark tucked into southwestern Darkshore where a colossal adamantine weapon stands impaled in a massive petrified skull. Long revered by local night elves as a sacred mystery, the site now swarms with Twilight's Hammer cultists drawn to the lingering malevolence of an ancient entity.

Rising out of the Darkshore earth, the Master's Glaive is a massive adamantine blade buried deep in a colossal petrified skull. No record names the creature that died here or the hand that drove the blade home. Onu, the Ancient of Lore, says only that an old, old lord of the earth fell on this spot, and the night elves long believed that only the titans could have wielded so gigantic a weapon. Today, the impaled monolith stands as a stark, petrified monument to that forgotten struggle.
